# Welcome to Payments

Requests for Payments arrive in the **PAY-OPS** queue. When
something is on fire, page payments-oncall.

## Your first week

| Day | Do this |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Get repository access and run the service locally. |
| 2 | Shadow a queue rotation in PAY-OPS. |
| 3 | Ship a small change through the release pipeline. |

Anything in this guide can be ordinary Markdown: tables, checklists, links.
